reason: In-band is a share of samples, and here two of the six parts are almost never in band: hub 2 is at 0.00 and link 2 at 0.05 (fast clip poses). Hub 2 sits at F 128 mm from GH. Its own disc need is a median 68 / p95 121 / max 128 mm, so in the median pose it stands about 60 mm off the back of the shoulder (design doc, 'Levers measured dead'). Part-weighted in-band is 0.497 (mean of hub1 1.00, hub2 0.00, hub3 0.674, link1 0.602, link2 0.051, neck 0.655) against the scored 0.504, so the sample weighting moves the gap only +0.71. Most of the routing gain is real, but part of it is dilution, and the design doc measures it: the routed link 1 has 340 samples against 245 straight, and weighted at the straight count k3484 scores 43.97 instead of 42.72. So 1.25 of the gain comes from extra in-band metal outweighing the hub that floats, not from that hub coming closer. Why watch: below the 3-point part-weight threshold, measured by the designer, and the gap still charges hub 2 fully (0 % in band). What the wearer gets is unchanged by routing: a 20 mm hub standing about 6 cm off the back and a link 2 that is out of band in 95 % of its samples.

reason: New pattern, proposed catalogue entry S7 (out-of-band depth blindness). The in-band term counts a sample at 15 mm and one at 60 mm the same: both are out of band. Once a part is out of band, the score does not care how far out it rides. The goal says every piece of metal rides about 1 cm off the skin. Here hub 2 rides about 60 mm off the skin in the median pose (F 128 mm vs a disc need of 68 mm median), and nothing in the gap separates this design from one whose hub 2 sits at 16 mm. That makes the score blind to the design's most visible profile defect: a 20 mm hub stack about 6 cm proud of the back, and link 2 bridging from it. Why watch: the design does not exploit the blindness to gain points (hub 2 already scores 0 % in band, and the designer measured that lowering it costs more in reach, qh2 0.97 -> 49.63). The pattern hides how low-profile the exo is, not where it ranks. Action: report a per-part standoff (median and p95 metal-skin distance over taken poses) beside in-band on rows and the board (report only, as proposed in the .md).
